activities.name: Circle Gifts
activities.description: Login event. Log in for a total of 7 days to earn Solid Dice x10.

activities.name: Pukaland Travelogue
activities.description: Limited-time event. Welcome to Pukaland, where your magical journey begins! Collect Wonder Stamps and unlock your exclusive park memories. During the event, complete limited-time encounters to earn Annulith, Fabricated Dice, Floe Cinema Tickets, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.

activities.name: Born to Race
activities.description: Limited-time Mystery Box event (NTE × Porsche collab). Spend Fons or Annulith to open "Born to Race" Mystery Boxes, with 15 boxes in total, and opening all of them unlocks every reward in the pool. Mystery Box contents include the Porsche collab vehicles "Porsche Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach Package" and "Porsche 911 Turbo (930)", Fabricated Dice, A Handwritten Letter, Fons, the limited avatar frame "Redline Rush", the exclusive namecard "Roar Recharged", and more.

activities.name: Everdriving
activities.description: Limited-time Mystery Box return event (NTE × Porsche collab). Spend Fons or Annulith to open "Everdriving" Mystery Boxes, with 15 boxes in total, and opening all of them unlocks every reward in the pool. Mystery Box contents include the Porsche collab vehicle "Porsche 918 Spyder", Esper Zero's limited collab outfit "Perfect Partners", Fabricated Dice x10, A Handwritten Letter x3, Fons x500,000, the limited avatar frame "Heartbeat Moment", the exclusive namecard "Trackside Shadow", and more. Previous Mystery Box progress carries over.

activities.name: Terminal Depths
activities.description: Limited-time event. Dear passengers, we are now approaching ** Station. Clear stages during the event to earn the title "Off-Rail Operator", Annulith, Fons, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.

activities.name: Circle Bounty
activities.description: Version 1.4 Circle Bounty. During the event, complete Circle Quests to earn Experience Points and raise your Circle Bounty Rank, unlocking Fabricated Dice, Gold Carrota, De-noise Solution, A Handwritten Letter, Eternal Shell Song, Development EXP Selection Box I, Expansion Core, and more.

activities.name: Stamina Recharge
activities.description: Limited-time event. During the event, spend City Stamina at 2x efficiency in "Hethereau Hobbies" activities.

activities.name: Beyond the Rails: Sunset Circle
activities.description: Limited-time event. Explore the railway route and take on challenges along the way.

activities.name: Coal Lump's Treasure
activities.description: Limited-time event. Keep those grubby little paws off Coal Lump's treasures! Take part during the event to earn the event currency "Prism Drop", and reach the target high scores to unlock the titles "Sweet Benefactor" and "Bestie Supreme". You can also visit the event shop to exchange for Annulith, Floe Cinema Tickets, Fons, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.

activities.name: Pixel Surge
activities.description: Limited-time event. During the event, spend Character Pixels in "Houdinii's Magic Stage", "Houdinii's Schemes", "Bubble Can Factory", and "Rabbit Hole" to receive double the rewards. Each day, double rewards apply to up to 120 Character Pixels spent. Unused daily allowance carries over, up to a total cap of 840 Character Pixels for the whole event.

activities.name: Snap! Golden Crackshot
activities.description: Limited-time event. Take part during the event to earn event currency, then visit the event shop to exchange it for Annulith, Fons, Floe Cinema Tickets, and more.

activities.name: Gold Crash
activities.description: Limited-time event. During the event, Fons earnings in "Pink Paws Heist" are doubled.

activities.name: Puka Lucky Flip
activities.description: Limited-time event. Complete daily tasks to earn flip chances, then use them to flip cards for a chance to win Annulith, Fabricated Dice, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.
